Simple or Unaware{{sup/md|SMD}} |pokemonname=Bidoof |prevonum=399 |epnum=Pokémon Mystery Dungeon: Explorers of Time & Darkness |epname=Pokémon Mystery Dungeon: Explorers of Time & Darkness |current=At [[Wigglytuff's Guild]] |enva1=[[Bill Rogers]] |java1=Tsutomu Densaka }} [[File:MDSky EP1.png|thumb|Bidoof in the Special Episode Bidoof's Wish]] '''Bidoof''' (Japanese: '''ビッパ''' ''Bippa'') is a [[non-player character]] in [[Pokémon Mystery Dungeon: Explorers of Time and Explorers of Darkness|Pokémon Mystery Dungeon: Explorers of Time, Darkness]], and [[Pokémon Mystery Dungeon: Explorers of Sky|Sky]]. He is a member of [[Wigglytuff's Guild]]. He stars in his own [[Special Episode]] in Explorers of Sky, entitled [[Bidoof's Wish]]. He is also a recruitable Pokémon in {{g|Super Mystery Dungeon}}. ==Background== {{spoilers}} Bidoof lived with his mother {{p|Bibarel}} and his two {{p|Bidoof}} siblings in a dam before going to train at [[Wigglytuff's Guild]]. He aspired to be the best explorer ever, so he left his hometown to be an apprentice at the guild. Bidoof was the newest member of the guild before the {{pkmn2|hero}} and their {{md|Partner Pokémon|partner}} came to train, and was always making some sort of mistake. He is only trusted with basic chores and errands because of his incompetence. Once, on a trip to [[Treasure Town]], Bidoof met a {{p|Snover}} that had been running from a {{p|Bagon}} and a {{p|Gligar}}. The Snover had a map to [[Star Cave]], which they wound up exploring together. At the end of the cave, Bidoof finds out that Snover had been working with the Pokémon that were chasing him the day before to mug him, but he was saved by the guild. {{mdc|Wigglytuff|2}} finds a way for him to go further in the cave, where he meets {{p|Jirachi}}. After battling a sleeping Jirachi, Bidoof wishes for some new apprentices to join the guild, who turn out to be the hero and their partner. ==Personality== Bidoof is seen as a kind, helpful Pokémon, that is loyal, and will believe his friends, as observed when he was the first to declare that he believed the partner's story about {{mdc|Dusknoir|2}}. His lacking experience at exploring and status as one of the most junior members of the guild is a recurring element in his character portrayal, and gets him into trouble multiple times, such as when he reveals the guild members during the hero's graduation exam. His big appetite is noted on several occasions, and is documented in {{mdc|Sunflora|2}}'s Oh My Gosh Diary. He often uses the interjection "by golly", and frequently punctuates his dialogue with the phrase "yup yup", which he also includes in the title of his diary, Bidoof's Yup Yup Journal. His character was fleshed out in [[Bidoof's Wish]], revealing that exploring has been a lifelong dream. His naivety is shown as he is duped by a band of thieves into being alone with them, giving them the chance to rob him. His goodness is also further proved when he finds {{p|Jirachi}} and is granted a wish. He turns down the opportunity to instantly become a great explorer, and instead wishes for "a {{tt|buddy or two|Revealed as the hero and their partner}}" that he could help, show around and give support to. {{endspoilers}} ==In the games== ===Explorers of Time, Darkness, and Sky=== In Explorers of Time, Darkness, and Sky, Bidoof was the one who gave the guild tour to the hero and their partner. He taught them much of what they know. On the expedition, Bidoof was grouped with the hero and their partner. He, like {{mdc|Sunflora|2}}, also kept a diary of events that happened to him throughout the game. ====Diary==== Bidoof's Yup Yup Journal is updated as the player progresses through the game.
